justiceLines.text: 📖 A man, maybe 40s, with a limp is showing A person, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair the broad smooth green leaves in spring colonies, strong onion smell when crushed — leaf, stem, smell.
👀 the person in their 50s, the er nurse starts a story with "back when I was an ER nurse..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
Word reaches you, days late: Tamika stands accused over what happened to Sofia. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
⚖ Tamika corners you by the stores, voice low. "Count it with me. Right now. If I'm wrong I'll say so in front of everyone."
(Find them and answer — pay restitution, or refuse. Attacking them answers too.)
[policy] refused the confrontation (justiceRespond -> {"refused":true})
⚖ Tamika stands, and the fire goes quiet around them. "No more talking around it. The thefts get a moot — all of it, in the open. You said no to me. Say it to everyone."
📓 Codex: They demanded a moot. Formal. No more hallway justice.

🔴 LIVE BREAKING NEWS! A MOOT has been CALLED! TAMIKA points at YOU — THEFT — TAKING WHAT WASN'T THEIRS! The gamblers are SCRAMBLING! Your CASE FILE is ready — check it before the fire decides your fate!
Tamika stands up at the fire, pointing. "This one. Theft — taking what wasn't theirs — and we all know it." Heads turn. 3 days until the moot. Use them.

Abdallah corners you by the fire. "We all eat from the same pot. You've been taking more than you bring for a while now. That can't continue — the village will decide." (Warning: pull weight or face a moot.)
👀 Rocco starts a story with "back when I was a doctor..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.

◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a gift.
👀 Logan was talking about home — then stopped mid-sentence, recalibrated, and said "Denver" just a fraction too deliberately. Whatever home is, it isn't where that sentence started.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
Tamika calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
🔴 LIVE — THE VERDICT IS IN! The galaxy holds its breath!
Tamika counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "10 for guilty. 0 against."
A pause long enough to live in. Someone's breath catches. Then: "Guilty." Nobody looks at anybody.
Exiled. You leave with what you carry — nothing more. Behind you, Haven keeps its fire. Ahead: the world, which just got much bigger.
📓 Codex: Exiled (moot). Walking.
The pantry is closed to you. The book stays behind. To Haven, you are not one of ours anymore. Membership asked nothing — no presence, no check-ins. Exile is the one way to lose it.
The pantry is not yours anymore. Exile means exile — membership had no check-ins, but it had exactly one way to lose it.
